title: Test scaffold
description: Add a tests/ directory with pytest configured (pytest.ini or requirements-dev.txt) and at least one real test covering an existing pure helper in dossier/ (e.g. momentum-scoring or a parsing function). This unblocks a 'run tests first' validation step for every subsequent feature.
notes: Added tests/ with pytest.ini and requirements-dev.txt. 38 tests cover _parse_market_cap, _parse_vol_string, check_quality (quality_filter.py), _clamp, and score_momentum (momentum_picks.py). All pass in 0.07s.

title: Input validation on external API responses
description: In the dossier data-fetch stage, add defensive checks for known failure shapes: empty payloads, Tradier's 'null' string, and missing yfinance keys. A bad upstream response should fail loudly with a clear message instead of silently corrupting downstream data.
notes: Added dossier/utils/validate_api.py with check_yfinance_history (validates required columns + min rows), check_yfinance_info (warns on empty fundamentals), is_tradier_null (Tradier "null" string + None + empty collection), and safe_json (guards JSON decode). Applied in ticker_enrichment.py, market_pulse.py, ghost_alpha_screener.py, and gamma_pin_screener.py. 33 new tests, all 71 pass.

title: Substack engagement resilience
description: In substack_social/, wrap network calls with bounded retries and clear logging so a transient failure does not abort the entire engage/pulse run. The vendored fork in vendor/ must not be modified.

title: Wire auto_backtest.py into the daily pipeline
description: Add auto_backtest.py as a late, guarded stage of the dossier run so backtest results are generated daily. A backtest failure must not fail the whole pipeline — log the error and continue.
